terms.comment: jugum is in the mountain entry.

phrases.latin: nam Osoitsa ad rādīcēs Haemī jacet, quī perpetuīs jugīs per tōtam Bulgariam ad Pontum ūsque tendit
phrases.english: for Osoitsa lies at the foot of the Haemus, which stretches in an unbroken range across all Bulgaria to the Black Sea

phrases.latin: Appennīnus mōns perpetuīs jugīs ab Alpibus tendēns ad …
phrases.english: the Apennines extending in an unbroken chain from the Alps to …

sources: Lewis & Short: jugum
